text:
Alex K: Heads up — noticed steady rise in per-host KV memory during long chats. Global hit_rate looks ok but per-session residency is low. Eviction counters show near-zero. Anyone else seeing weirdness?
Mira S: Saw that too. Pulled a flamegraph — hot path is `kv_lookup()` iterating lots of tiny fragments. I think fragmentation + our sampling window is hiding short-lived evictions.
Mira S: Prometheus quick check:
```
sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (host)
# returned ~0.02 for most hosts, looks flat
```
Jamie L: The hit-rate panels average across hosts which masks skew. Try per-session quantiles instead — e.g.
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_residency_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, session))
```
This shows a long tail for a few sessions.
Devon R: Also seeing memory growth on long-context load tests. Our sampler only takes one sample/min, so quick eviction spikes are missed. Proposal: add a short-window sampler (10s) and a sampled eviction counter `kv_evictions_sampled_total`.
Devon R: Example feature-flag config:
```
kv_sampler:
  short_window_enabled: true
  short_window_seconds: 10
```
Mira S: Canary deployed short-window sampler to staging. Eviction spikes appear and line up with drops in per-session residency. Updated the staging dashboard panels to surface p50/p95 residency and sampled evictions.
Alex K: Can we add an alert: `kv_residency_low` when p50 < 0.6 for >120s? Also include model and model_version labels so routing can fall back.
Alex K: @infra-bot can you flip `kv.sampler.short_window` in prod (feature flag) when we give the go? :pray:
infra-bot: deploy request accepted — applying flag change to staging now.
infra-bot: deploy:kv-sampler v3 -> staging succeeded at 1956790500
Jamie L: I'll update the dashboard description and add a note in /docs/kv/metrics.md about the sampling bias and how to interpret `kv_evictions_sampled_total` :memo:
Devon R: Plan: roll short-window sampler to prod behind FF, monitor 24h, watch p95 eviction rate and eviction latency. If stable, flip on permanently. :thumbsup:
Alex K: Thanks all — keeping this thread for follow-ups. Will post 24h summary.
